tasks.short: Signal equipment operators to align machinery and materials.

steps.what: Confirm the machinery movement before the first signal
Signal equipment operators during alignment and movement
Stop the signal when materials or people are in the way

tasks.design: The laborer still watches the machinery, the load and the people, and still signals by hand or voice. No system sends the signal, and no record of the signal is kept. The operator still drives.
tasks.previous_blocker: The operator has to see the signal in the moment, and a wrong signal can strike a person or a load.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing new lets a system see the swing of a load. The signal stays with the person who can see it.
tasks.still_hard: The operator and the laborer must see each other, and the load can move into someone's path between signals.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing a person or material in the path and stopping the movement at once.
tasks.altitude: The laborer still stands where the operator can see them and still gives every signal. Nothing about who may direct the machine changes.

reach.task: Position machinery from the laborer's signal
reach.learn: Which signal meant stop and which meant a small adjustment.

evidence.claim: A signal to an equipment operator is given by hand or voice while both people can see the load. A wrong signal can harm someone, and a device that cannot see the swing cannot replace the signaller. Model knowledge.

assumptions: No device is introduced, so there is no upkeep. The zero allowance below is because nothing is built.
The operator drives the machine. This task is only the signal.
Nothing is recorded, so there is no location log and no score of the laborer.
A second person who relays a signal the operator cannot see is still a person giving a signal.
unknowns: Whether this site already uses a fixed hand-signal code the operator and the laborer both know.
How often the operator cannot see the laborer and a second person relays the signal.
research_questions: How often a signal is missed because the operator's view of the laborer is blocked.
Whether a written lift plan already names who may signal.

incremental.description: No system is added, so there is no ongoing upkeep for this task.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Every movement still needs a person who can see the machinery, the materials and the people, so none of this task's time moves.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read plans and specifications to determine work activities.

steps.what: Find the plans or specifications for today's area
Draft this laborer's activities from the written instructions

loop.purpose: Draft a short list of this laborer's activities from the instruction text for today's area.
loop.input: The instruction text and the named sheet id.
loop.output: An activity list draft, one line per activity the text states.
loop.check: The laborer compares each activity to a line or a dimension on the plan and rejects an activity the text does not state.
loop.stop: The plan is a line drawing with no instruction text, or the laborer rejects the list.
loop.why_not_simpler: The instruction mixes several trades in free text, so a fixed template cannot tell which lines are this laborer's.

steps.what: Read the plans on site with the craft worker
Determine the work activities the plans require

tasks.design: When the work plan in {PROJECT} names a sheet and holds instruction text, {DOCS} opens that sheet and drafts a short activity list. The laborer still reads the plans on site with the craft worker and still decides what the ground requires. A line drawing with no text produces no draft.
tasks.previous_blocker: The laborer is on the ground, the plans are often a paper set in the cabin, and the instruction mixes several trades.
tasks.enabler_now: When a work plan names the sheet and holds instruction text, that sheet can be opened and a draft list can be checked against the text.
tasks.still_hard: Matching a line on the plan to the ground, and deciding the work when the drawing has no written instruction.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing whether the plan matches the site, and rejecting an activity the plan does not state.
tasks.altitude: The laborer still reads the plans with the craft worker and still decides the work. Finding a named sheet takes less time when the instruction is text. No new right to change the plan.

reach.task: Set the day's work from the plans
reach.learn: Which plan lines the laborer could not match to the ground.

evidence.claim: The laborer still has to match a plan line to the ground. A draft list can restate written instructions, and it cannot see whether the site matches the drawing. Model knowledge.
Hours, location and job logs kept per person can observe presence and performance, and works-council consent is required first.
An AI system is high-risk when it allocates tasks from individual behaviour or personal traits, or evaluates worker performance.

assumptions: The work plan holds job id, area, sheet id, and instruction text when the instruction is text. The supervisor produces those fields. A missing sheet id is a cabin search, and that time stays in the find step.
A line drawing with no instruction text stops the draft. The laborer then reads the drawing on site as today.
The activity list is a draft for this job. It does not store a score, a location or attendance.
Test the project tool's own document link before any custom code. Paper sets in the cabin remain.
Upkeep is fixing a wrong sheet link. There is no separate admin baseline.
unknowns: How often the instruction is only a spoken briefing, with no text on the sheet.
Whether several paper revisions for the same area sit in the cabin at once.
research_questions: How often the laborer is handed a sheet that is not the revision the supervisor named.
What share of plans are line drawings with no written instruction.

already_counted.description: Check the opened sheet is the revision named on the work plan.
Reject any drafted activity the instruction text does not state.

incremental.description: Fix a sheet link when the named revision is not the one on site.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Most of the day the supervisor points at the ground, and a drawing with no instruction text gives the draft nothing to list.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The laborer still signals equipment operators and still reads the plans on the ground. A named sheet opens faster when the instruction is text. No new authority over the machine.
reach: Equipment operator: which signal meant stop.
First-line supervisor of construction trades: which plan lines the laborer could not match to the ground.
skills_to_grow: Give a stop signal the operator can see
Match a plan line to the ground
Reject an activity the plan does not state
role.ambitious_version: The named sheet and a short activity draft open when the instruction is text. The laborer still signals by hand and still decides the work from the ground.
